files.view.reading: Reading the files git does not manage.
files.view.title: Files git does not manage
files.view.lead: What git leaves out of {{repository}}'s folder, and what Daoris does with each path. Add a rule of your own to change one.
files.view.body: What Daoris does with the files in {{repository}}'s folder that git neither tracks nor holds as a session's work: the rule that decides each path, the layer it came from and what the layers below it said.
files.view.read: Read at {{commit}}; the analysis last read it at {{found}}.
files.view.neverRead: Read at {{commit}}; the analysis has not written its rules yet, so the found rules shown are this reading's.
files.view.keptLead: Each of these paths of your rules matches a folder without what lies under it, which git's syntax cannot say, so Daoris reads it as you wrote it. Choose a wording for each, and your rules are rewritten in git's syntax in one write; until then nothing else is written to them.
files.view.keptWhole: The folder and everything in it: {{patterns}}
files.view.keptFiles: Only the files it matched, not its folders: {{patterns}}
files.view.keptNone: Nothing: it named only the folder
files.view.firstForm: {{repository}}'s own rule file says no form, so its paths are read in the older form, not in git's syntax.
files.view.unread: Your file rules do not read ({{why}}). Daoris holds every install, copy and share they could restrict until they read, and writes nothing over the file.
files.view.none: Git leaves no ignored files here.
files.view.floor.tracked: Git tracks it, so it is git's.
files.view.floor.repository: Another repository or tree: never touched.
files.view.floor.never-copied: An agent's or an editor's settings: never copied.
files.view.idle.no-install: It names and inherits no install and no key, so it acts on nothing.
files.view.copy: Copied read-only into each tree from the checkout; every session working in a tree can read the copy.
files.view.copyVerdict.made: It is made at the next start.
files.view.copyVerdict.denied: Your permissions deny it, so it is not made.
files.view.copyVerdict.held: An ask holds it until you allow it.
files.view.acts: What Daoris would do in a tree
files.view.actsNone: These rules name no install, copy or share.
files.view.permissionsNone: You have set no permission, so everything runs.
files.view.rulesNone: You have set no rule of your own, so the repository's and the found rules decide.
files.view.cannot.no-checkout: This repository has no checkout on this machine, so its files cannot be read.
files.view.cannot.unreadable: Git could not read this repository's files. Daoris reads them from the repository's own top folder: check that the folder it holds for this repository is that folder (Manage shows it), or run `git status` there to see what git says.
files.view.refusedPress.unread: Your file rules do not read, so nothing was written over them: fix the file, then try again.
files.view.refusedPress.no-checkout: This repository has no checkout on this machine, so nothing was read.
files.view.refusedPress.unreadable: Git could not read this repository's files.
